reason: I already put the same amount into index funds every month for free in my broker app and barely look at it, so paying a monthly fee for an agent to do roughly the same thing just eats into my returns. The pet is cute, but I'm not paying a subscription to invest.
objection: A monthly fee is a guaranteed cost on top of money that's supposed to compound, and I'd be handing real money to an AI from a company with no broker partner, no price and no track record yet.
would_change_my_mind: A free or near-free real-money tier with a named, licensed broker holding my account, plus proof over a year of demo use that the agent actually beats my plain monthly index buys after the fee.
